texte.Sécuriser la chaîne d'approvisionnement: Secure the AI supply chain (model providers, third-party APIs, data)
texte.Sécurité des personnes en milieu confiné: Safety of people in confined spaces
texte.Sécurité des systèmes de contrôle indust: Security of industrial control systems. Robustness testing against cyberattacks and failures. IEC #.
texte.Sécurité du développement et minimisatio: Secure development and minimisation by default
texte.Sécurité dès la conception, gestion docu: Security by design, documented vulnerability handling, security updates throughout the support period (# years minimum).
texte.Sélectionner et mettre en œuvre les cont: Select and implement the relevant Annex A controls for each system

Select at least one use case.
texte.Sélectionnez des cas d’usage (étape #) p: Select use cases (step #) for the gap analysis.
texte.Sélectionnez un client et chargez son éc: Select a client and load their payment schedule.
texte.Sélectionnez vos cas d’usage (étape #),: Select your use cases (step #), score them on the # axes (step #), then quantify the expected return (step #).
texte.Sélectionnez votre rôle pour un enchaîne: Select your role for a recommended sequence of pages — relevant for a micro-enterprise as much as for a large account; the level of detail adapts to your context.
texte.Sélectionnez, notez et chiffrez vos cas: Select, score and cost your AI use cases (steps # to #).
texte.Sépare ce qui bloque le cas d’usage de c: Separates what blocks the use case from what blocks the organisation: two distinct action plans.
texte.Sépare ce qui se corrige dans le produit: Separates what is fixed in the product from what is fixed in the organisation.
texte.Séquencez PoC, MVP puis industrialisatio: Sequence PoC, MVP then industrialisation, with the compliance milestones on the same dates.
texte.Séquencez les actions restantes sur un c: Sequence the remaining actions on a calendar with deadlines.
texte.TPE : # page suffit pour piloter visuell: Micro-enterprise: # page is enough to steer your priorities visually in the executive committee.
texte.TPE : # à # documents bien organisés val: Micro-enterprise: # to # well-organised documents are worth more than # scattered ones.
texte.TPE : # à # systèmes suffisent souvent à: Micro-enterprise: # to # systems are often enough to get started. Large account: structure by subsidiary or business division from the outset to avoid tedious rework.
texte.TPE : commencez par les moyens de paieme: Micro-enterprise: start with the means of payment and sign-ins with a work account. Large account: cross-check with the proxy logs and the SaaS catalogue before questioning the teams.
texte.TPE : commencez par vos #-# systèmes les: Micro-enterprise: start with your #-# most critical systems by volume of data processed.
texte.TPE : concentrez-vous sur # à # cas tran: Micro-enterprise: focus on # to # cross-functional cases with a fast ROI. Large account: cross-reference this mapping with the AI Act compliance milestones of the RaaS module to link value and compliance.
texte.TPE : concentrez-vous sur #-# piliers le: Micro-enterprise: focus on the #-# pillars most critical to your business. Large account: repeat the assessment by division to map the internal gaps.
texte.TPE : suffit à sécuriser une décision GO: Micro-enterprise: enough to secure a quick GO/NO-GO decision before any investment. Large account: make this step a mandatory milestone before any AI commitment committee.
texte.TPE : traitez d’abord les points P# (san: Micro-enterprise: address the P# items first (direct penalties). Large account: delegate entire sections to identified business leads.
texte.TPE : un seul référent polyvalent peut s: Micro-enterprise: a single all-round lead may be enough to start with; formalise their role clearly.
texte.Tableau de bord de la conformité du site: Dashboard of the compliance of the CONSEILPREV site and of the Sentinel platform themselves: verification against Articles #, #, #, # and #, consent records, transfers, data subject rights.
texte.Tableau de bord d’adoption — à lire à cô: Adoption dashboard — to be read alongside the compliance index, never instead of it.
texte.Tableau de bord exécutif consolidé : KPI: Consolidated executive dashboard: strategic KPIs, breakdown of the register by classification, latest assessments — designed for presentation to your senior management or client.
texte.Tableau de bord global : juridictions co: Global dashboard: jurisdictions covered, average regulatory severity, innovation/severity rankings. Starting point for exploring AI compliance worldwide.
texte.Tableau d’empreinte par pays et fiches p: Footprint table by country and country profiles, on screen and in print.
texte.Tableau d’empreinte par pays et fond de: Footprint table by country and “carbon intensity” base map.
texte.Tant qu’elle ne l’est pas, un accès créé: Until it is, an access created does not guarantee that a client sees only their own data. Check this before opening the first access.
texte.Tarification par résultats vérifiés · Rè: Pricing on verified outcomes · Regulation (EU) #/# (AI Act) · Prepared on
texte.Taux de conformité — ce que le plan ne p: Compliance rate — what the plan cannot do
texte.Taux de conversion +# à +# % ; coût par: Conversion rate +# to +# %; cost per acquisition −# %.
texte.Taux de gain estimé : productivité, qual: Estimated gain rate: productivity, quality or time saved, as a % of the base. Pre-filled by technology family.
texte.Temps de recherche −# % ; sources citées: Search time −# %; sources cited and verifiable.
texte.Temps de réponse −# % ; résolution au #e: Response time −# %; resolution on #st contact +# pts.
texte.Temps moyen de validation d'un projet IA: Average time to approve an AI project
texte.Tenir le dispositif dans la durée: Keep the framework running over time
texte.Tenir le dossier à jour lors de toute mo: Keep the file up to date upon any substantial modification
texte.Tenir à jour les informations d'enregist: Keep the registration information up to date in the event of changes
texte.Tenir à jour un registre des systèmes ha: Keep a register of high-risk systems up to date
texte.Tests de residualite confirmes sur le sy: Residual risk tests confirmed on the final system (Art. #(#))
texte.Texte consolide du Journal officiel de l: Consolidated text from the Official Journal of the European Union.
texte.Texte redige par CONSEILPREV a partir de: Text written by CONSEILPREV from general public sources by country. Penalties and main framework to be checked individually before client use (national legislation not systematically audited).
texte.Textes applicables repérés dès publicati: Applicable texts identified on publication; deadlines met.
texte.Textes réglementaires (sources officiell: Regulatory texts (official sources, news) and Obligations article by article (# articles of the Regulation, filterable by role: provider, deployer, GPAI).
texte.Tolérance aux entrées erronées, dérives: Tolerance to erroneous inputs, sensor drift, degraded conditions. Real-world testing before deployment (Art. #).
texte.Tolérance zéro aux interruptions. Superv: Zero tolerance for interruptions. Effective human oversight (Art. #) of automated load-shedding or dispatch decisions.
texte.Total des jalons applicables à votre rôl: Total of the milestones applicable to your role and profile (#-month base included)
texte.Tous les leviers sont déclarés sur toute: All levers are declared on all rows.
texte.Tout code qui décide d’un droit d’une pe: Any code that decides on a person’s right
texte.Tout ne mérite pas le circuit complet :: Not everything deserves the full workflow: claiming otherwise breeds workarounds, that is, shadow AI.
texte.Tout part de là, et deux défauts suffise: Everything starts here, and two defects are enough to undo the whole exercise: acceptance criteria written AFTER the rating, and a residual risk that nobody has accepted in writing. Neither shows in the final document.
texte.Tout système identifié doit être enregis: Every system identified must be recorded — even if the risk is minimal (traceability + periodic review).
texte.Tout traitement de données personnelles: Any processing of personal data (including the training of an AI model) must rest on a valid legal basis. Legitimate interest is often chosen for the training phase, subject to a documented balancing test.
texte.Toute décision se motive, y compris un r: Every decision is reasoned, including a refusal.
texte.Toute personne physique faisant l'objet: Every natural person subject to a decision taken or assisted by the system is informed of this use.
texte.Toute restriction imposée à un contenu d: Any restriction imposed on content must be clearly explained to the user concerned.
texte.Toute équipe métier — marketing, RH, jur: Any business team — marketing, HR, legal, finance, operations
texte.Toutes les lignes portent un volume et s: All rows carry a volume and its source.
texte.Toutes les obligations ne sont pas encor: Not all obligations are applicable yet. The prohibited practices (art. #) have applied since # February #, general-purpose models since # August #, Annex III high-risk from # December # and Annex I from # August #.
texte.Toutes équipes (Métiers, IT, Data, Jurid: All teams (Business, IT, Data, Legal, Senior management)
texte.Tracabilite des revisions, incidents et: Traceability of revisions, incidents and quality decisions
texte.Traduction juridique ou médicale automat: Automated legal or medical translation, automatic subtitling, AI-driven content localisation
texte.Traduction non officielle des Generative: Unofficial translation of the Chinese Generative AI Measures (CAC).
texte.Traitement données d'entraînement — Base: Processing of training data — legal basis required
texte.Traitements impliquant un transfert hors: Processing involving a transfer outside the EU; check the appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses, adequacy decision).
texte.Traitements portant sur des données part: Processing of special categories of data (health, biometrics, opinions, orientation…), subject to enhanced safeguards.
texte.Traitez d’abord les points P# : ce sont: Address the P# items first: they are the ones that block placing on the market, not only those that expose you to a penalty.
texte.Traitez d’abord les points qui exposent: First address the items that expose you to a direct penalty: not everything can be tackled at once.
texte.Traitez les exigences COMMUNES avant les: Address the COMMON requirements before the specific ones: they carry the foundation, and dealing with them once saves three times the work.
texte.Tranchez les trente-huit mesures. Écrive: Decide on the thirty-eight controls. Write the reason AT THE MOMENT you decide.
texte.Transforme la maturité générale en plan: Turns general maturity into a concrete action plan, item by item, with the exact legal reference.
texte.Transforme une déclaration d’intention e: Turns a statement of intent into an enforceable control framework in the event of an inspection.
texte.Transforme une intention IA en une liste: Turns an AI intention into a shortlist of prioritised use cases, costed and judged deployable — the basis of a programme geared to business value.
texte.Transparence & explication aux déployeur: Transparency & explanation to deployers and data subjects
texte.Transparence des systèmes de recommandat: Transparency of recommender systems for platforms; the interplay with the AI Act plays out on the same interface.
texte.Transport ferroviaire, aérien, routier,: Rail, air and road transport, logistics and car manufacturers.
texte.Travail temporaire et agences d'emploi,: Temporary work and employment agencies, customer contact centres, private security, cleaning, business services.
texte.Traçable et peu coûteux. Le lien se perd: Traceable and inexpensive. The link is lost at the first history overwrite or the first file port, but it holds in ordinary use.
texte.Trente-deux sous-articles, trente-huit m: Thirty-two sub-clauses, thirty-eight controls. The order in which you take them decides the timeline: the statement of applicability depends on the risk assessment, which depends on the scope. Starting with the controls because they are concrete means redoing the statement three times.
texte.Trente-huit mesures sur les données, le: Thirty-eight controls on data, the model lifecycle and the impact on people: none has an equivalent in #.
texte.Trente-six mesures mises en œuvre et deu: Thirty-six controls implemented and two empty boxes: the audit stops. Eighteen included and twenty excluded, all justified: it passes.
texte.Tri croissant/decroissant sur le meme je: Ascending/descending sort on the same JURS dataset (JS table), no separate source.
texte.Tri de CV, scoring candidats, matching p: CV screening, candidate scoring, job/profile matching
texte.Tri et orientation automatique des recla: Automatic sorting and routing of customer complaints.
texte.Tri et scoring automatique des candidatu: Automatic sorting and scoring of applications against defined criteria.
texte.Triage des urgences par IA, aide au diag: AI-driven emergency triage, diagnostic aid, patient prioritisation systems, prescribing AI
texte.Trois colonnes, pas deux : décision, jus: Three columns, not two: decision, justification, AND implementation status. The third is the one the auditor cross-checks on the ground.
texte.Trois décisions qui, prises tard, se pai: Three decisions which, if taken late, are paid for in code rework and uncertainty over ownership.
texte.Trois méthodes sur les mêmes volumes déc: Three methods on the same declared volumes; fine-tuning is amortised and totalled SEPARATELY from inference.
texte.Trois natures, jamais mélangées, toujour: Three natures, never mixed, always written in the tooltip. “published”: the operator has published the figure. “site”: calculated from the announced capacity OF THIS SITE. “class”: calculated from the typical order of magnitude of its category — this answers “what order of magnitude is a campus of this type?”, never “how much does this site consume?”. As none of the # sites publishes capacity, PUE or consumption, almost everything is of the “class” nature — and the page tells you so rather than dressing it up.
texte.Trois risques ne rencontrent aucune mesu: Three risks meet no Annex A control: no framework will catch them.
texte.Trois usages distincts : qualifier une s: Three distinct uses: qualify a situation against the applicable texts, run a draft contract through the supplier clause library, and prepare an arbitration position. The qualification is deterministic — it applies written rules, not an interpretation.
texte.Trois voies, selon ce qui est en jeu: Three routes, depending on what is at stake
texte.Tu es Sentinel, expert reglementaire IA: You are Sentinel, CONSEILPREV’s AI regulatory expert (Paris, France). Reply in French with precision and concision (max # words). Areas: EU AI Act (Reg. #/#), NIS #, GDPR, DORA, ISO #, ISO #, AI governance, cybersecurity. For any audit or project: christophe.cerf@outlook.com. No legal advice — expert guidance. Current page context:
texte.Tu es consultant senior CONSEILPREV spec: You are a senior CONSEILPREV consultant specialising in AI governance. Draft a detailed operational deliverable for the next phase of an EU AI Act compliance plan.
texte.Tu es un analyste juridique specialise e: You are a legal analyst specialising in international AI regulation. Reply only in strict JSON.

texte.Types de données traitées par le système: Types of data processed by the system — personal, biometric, professional data…
texte.Téléchargement impossible : vérifiez vot: Download not possible: check your connection.
texte.UTC — les fichiers servis sont relus à c: UTC — the files served are re-read at each measurement; the “Compliant” box remains a human attestation.
texte.Un PoC inscrit au registre se transforme: A PoC recorded in the register becomes an MVP without documentation rework — a PoC not recorded pays for it twice.
texte.Un argumentaire d’implantation opposable: An enforceable siting rationale, instead of a preference justified after the fact.
texte.Un article de # à # ne se déclare pas «: A clause from # to # cannot be declared “Not applicable”: they are requirements. Only Annex A controls can be excluded.
texte.Un article non déclaré compte pour zéro: An undeclared article counts as zero and stays in the denominator. Silence does not lighten the requirement.
texte.Un assistant bâti sur un modèle tiers et: An assistant built on a third-party model and put into service under your name can make you a downstream provider. The qualification is decided at scoping, not at go-live.
texte.Un audit bâclé désigne les mauvaises for: A botched audit points to the wrong courses. If the proposed order surprises you, it is the audit that needs redoing, not the list.
texte.Un audit interne conduit par celui qui a: An internal audit conducted by the person who wrote the system is not one. Independence is checked on the organisation chart.
texte.Un avis de valeur produit par un modèle: A valuation opinion produced by a model and given to a client remains the professional’s opinion. The Hoguet Act knows no algorithmic exemption.
texte.Un axe déclaré au-dessus de sa famille #: An axis declared above its #-# family is brought back down to it, and the excess is FLAGGED: that is where the gap shows between what you believe you have tailored and what you actually have underneath.
texte.Un aéroréfrigérant sec affiche zéro eau: A dry cooler shows zero ON-SITE water while consuming more at the source on a thermal grid: WUE_source = WUE_site + EWIF × PUE.
